title: Career Site Job Listing API
description: Extract job listings from any major career site. Paste a job board URL and the actor auto-detects the platform.

startUrls.title: Job Board URLs
startUrls.description: Add one or more supported career board URLs.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of jobs
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of job listings to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on number of API pages to fetch.

allow_html_detail_fallback.title: Allow HTML detail fallback (BreezyHR/iCIMS/Taleo only)
allow_html_detail_fallback.description: When enabled, fetches job detail pages only for boards that may miss API description fields.
